item.title: In all the grandiose discussion about colonising Mars, I don…
item.author: Mike Sowden (@mikeachim.bsky.social)
item.description:
In all the grandiose discussion about colonising Mars, I don't see much about how the soil is poisonous to us.

This was only discovered in 2008. It contains perchlorates, which are environmental toxins here on Earth.

Any human contact with Mars dust? Super-bad news in the long run.

1/
